scope: Finite opt-in formal-world pilot. Resource presence has geographic support. ALL operative quantities below are development assumptions, not measured 1900 land, yields or French reserves.

quantity_units.grain_coal_flour: development_kg: one Native unit denotes one developer kilogram. Divide by 1000 only for mass reporting; this grants no national statistical coverage or macro inventory conversion.
quantity_units.bread: development_piece, with no admitted piece-to-kg or calorie conversion
quantity_units.money: Original Ledger denomination:formal_simulation_minor_v1, not historical francs or macro centimes
quantity_units.logistics_storage: Pilot legacy edge/node capacities are Native business quantities/day, not railway tonnes. StockLots records quantity and title; this pilot has no bound physical warehouse facility. Regional Shared payload/storage units require their separate declared conversions.

scale_comparisons.entry: EconomyNetworkDevelopment.resource_scale_request; opt-in WorldBootstrap configuration, never applied to an existing world
scale_comparisons.balanced: Scale land, finite seeds/opening stocks/capital, aggregate members/labor, processing capacity and quotas, mineral quantities and legacy daily route/node allowances together. Keep per-unit inputs, work, prices and calendar rules unchanged. Merchant receives a four-times-factor grain restocking target, paid from its own funds.
scale_comparisons.surplus: Double land and provide the extra finite opening seed allocation; labor and buyers unchanged. Sowing is still limited by the one-day labor budget.
scale_comparisons.shortage: Ten times buyer members and their declared opening cash; farmer members, land, seeds, labor and production remain at balanced quantities. Additional members do not grant additional jobs or wages.
scale_comparisons.bottleneck: Keep balanced goods, actors and money; retain only one hundredth of the balanced route/node allowance.
scale_comparisons.basis: Development scale comparisons, not measured 1900 France. No in-run cash, stock, land or deposit top-ups. Original resource_request remains unchanged. Food rates, farm population/land ratios and throughput are uncalibrated.

calculation_rules.capacity: One capacity per resource id. Multiple admitted actors share it; actor creation or succession never resets land or geological remaining quantity.
calculation_rules.permission: Producer land_use_units and optional from_day/until_day are explicit development use permissions, not historical property titles. Resource presence alone grants no use right.
calculation_rules.weather: Unspecified years use development weather factor 1000, not observed historical weather. A bounded 1901 factor-500 comparison changes harvest through the production formula.
calculation_rules.mineral_remaining: Derived from original extraction source receipts across all operators. Discovery changes knowledge only. The opportunity-cost gate uses the exact milli quotation, not its rounded integer unit ceiling.

unknown: Measured coal resources/discoveries and mine titles

resources.geographic_basis: Rouen market catchment in France; not a cadastral parcel or a claim that the city centre is farmland
Country-level French coal occurrence; Lyon is the pilot market collection point, NOT an asserted mine coordinate. Loire coal occurrence does not prove a Lyon deposit.
resources.cost_basis: Reservation/opportunity cost in pilot money; not a paid invoice or guaranteed profit. Remaining 40 units stay undiscovered.

cycle_comparisons.entry: EconomyNetworkDevelopment.resource_cycle_request(100, scenario); old resource_request/resource_scale_request remain separate controls
cycle_comparisons.source_scope: Allen 2001 Table 3 is a comparative premodern European basket (182kg bread/year, 5 million BTU fuel/year), not measured Rouen/Lyon 1900 consumption. Food mass range is a developer extrapolation; fuel heat values are modern physical reference, not stove efficiency.
cycle_comparisons.food_service: One food unit denotes one gram of dry-staple approximation: grain/flour kg=1000, bread piece=500 (0.5kg flour input). Not exact calories, complete diet or protein adequacy. Developer range 400-650g/adult/day; selected farmers/wage workers 500, miners 600.
cycle_comparisons.fuel_service: One fuel unit=1MJ fuel input; coal kg=25MJ (IPCC other bituminous coal reference 25.8, interval 19.9-30.5). Household range 8-16MJ/person/day, selected 10; wood and other fuels are not admitted sources in this pilot. No useful-heat/stove conversion.
cycle_comparisons.population_and_land: 100-scale case uses 20 farmer +10 miner +5 mill worker +5 bakery worker adults from existing host population, the same 10ha and annual potential 12150kg. Capacity units regrouped from 100m2 to1000m2, 20kg seed and150kg base yield per unit; selected sow/harvest 1 person-hour/unit are developer work rates, not historical labor measurements. Growing/cooking/threshing labor is incomplete.
cycle_comparisons.ownership: Self-employed output belongs to its cohort; self-use consumes its original lots. Enterprises own processing output and owe real wages. Crop seed and forthcoming household use are retained before sale; no goods or cash are granted after opening.
cycle_comparisons.opening_cash: Declared before simulation, not replenished: resource cohorts30/person, workers60/person; enterprise working capital is old100-scale/20. Crop and merchant opening grain remain3200/2400kg. Carryover food, financial endowments and nominal wage8/hour are assumptions, not francs or measured wealth.
cycle_comparisons.processing: Mill5kg grain->4kg flour+1kg reject,1kg coal,1person-hour; bakery5kg flour+1kg coal->10bread portions,2person-hours. Flour extraction80% uses Allen83% as an order-of-magnitude reference. Equipment, throughput, fuel and labor are developer assumptions; water and wet bread mass are unmodeled.
cycle_comparisons.decision_policy: Actual delivered sales over30days set inventory coverage (14days normal,7adjusted) with bounded probe and target ceiling. Merchant rejects landed cost above its own current ask (adjusted requires10% quote spread), without guaranteed profit. Mine production is constrained by inventory, labor, price and discovered remaining. Adjusted processing queues only currently useful shifts; old fixed-hours rules remain available.
cycle_comparisons.shocks: 1901 weather factor500 reduces actual harvest; day30 original action disables downstream bakery activity, or lowers existing route daily capacity to1/100. No final outputs/prices are prescribed.

unmapped_needs.beans_peas: Allen52litres/year comparative reference; no admitted producer here
unmapped_needs.meat_dairy_eggs: Allen26kg meat,5.2kg butter,5.2kg cheese,52eggs/year; no mappings here
unmapped_needs.clothing_hygiene_light: Allen5m linen,2.6kg soap,2.6kg candles,2.6litres oil/year; goods exist in broader catalog but no configured supply in this slice
unmapped_needs.housing_water_health: No quantity/service mapping in this slice; unmet scope remains unknown, not zero
